summary: Verified the quality refactor with 32 passing pytest cases, official hook/key ESLint (0 errors/warnings), read-only public API consistency checks, real Gemini API/browser responses, and desktop 1920x800/mobile 390x844 UI checks. Receipt download success/404/storage exception503/malformed503 all pass without UnboundLocalError. Three frontend recovery/loading defects remain.

ui_bugs.issue: After initial conversation-list 503, Tentar novamente performs no request and leaves the failure visible. Reproduced with TEST ONLY interception: request count remained 2 before/after clicking retry.
While history request is pending, the history section renders as empty without a loading indicator. Delayed TEST ONLY response confirmed page-loading count 0.

integration_issues.issue: A 503 from /api/alerts leaves /alertas on an indefinite loading spinner, with no error or retry action. TEST ONLY fault injection reproduced this; real alerts API responds normally.

action_items: HIGH: Pass alertResource.error/reload/loading into the alerts screen; distinguish failed requests from pending ones and offer retry.
MEDIUM: Add conversation-history reload behavior; advisor retry currently handles only a prior send attempt.
LOW: Render a loading state while spreadsheet import history is being fetched.

Retest these error paths using interception only; preserve production records. Optionally verify real conversation deletion UI with settled modal transitions, using a newly created exact test-owned ID.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js discards alertResource.error/reload; Alerts.jsx returns Loading whenever feed is null, including permanent failure.
useAdvisorChat.retry does nothing when lastAttempt.current is null, but ChatInput shows that retry for initial history-load failures too.
Spreadsheets.jsx consumes resource.error/data but never resource.loading.

Receipt content now returns bytes or raises503 directly. All required faults passed; no uninitialized-variable failure observed. Existing is None/is True/is False idioms remain valid and should not be changed.

Hooks/key official rules passed with no hook-rule suppressions found. Finance tests verify all45 account mappings, formula fixtures, alert thresholds, all14 original export sheets/formulas/styles plus audit ledger. Import tests use exclusively fake DB.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (27/30 evaluated feature scenarios; excludes corrected harness/wait failures)

test_credentials: No login or authentication flow; no secrets printed.
seed_data_creation: No seed/reset/migration executed. Two UI TEST_ transactions were created and deleted only by returned IDs; full original transaction snapshot remains identical. Three own conversations across pytest/browser runs were soft-deleted by their exact IDs; stored test messages intentionally remain preserved. Existing receipts/conversations/diagnostics/acknowledgements were not modified. No real workbook import.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only run the two new quality pytest files, not destructive legacy suites. Final authoritative log: quality-final-t1.log (32 passed). Earlier quality-pytest-t1.log failures were missing pytest-asyncio in the test harness, corrected to installed AnyIO; initial ESLint legacy flags corrected to a test-only flat configuration. Delayed resources proved old Transactions/Receipts/diagnostics responses cannot overwrite a new month. Advisor draft persists after URL clearing; synchronous duplicate lock allows one POST; streamed-error retry sends server user_message_id and keeps one user bubble; new-chat/history race and month/navigation cancellation pass. Diagnostics terminal done and accelerated135s timeout pass. Real Gemini completion/persistence/reopening pass. Expense/income account filter/save refreshes meta/dashboard/alerts; exact transaction cleanup preserves all original records. Receipt viewer, DRE comparison/detail, chart modes/donut and mobile overflow/menu pass. TEST ONLY MOCKED routes were used for failure/cancellation/acknowledgement/delete-dialog UI tests; app integrations themselves are real. Actual chat deletion UI after rapid cancel/reopen failed once with a generic toast; direct real soft-delete API succeeded, and settled-animation intercepted UI passed, so this combined real UI flow remains incompletely verified rather than a confirmed API defect. No production deployment verified.
rca of the issue: Three independent UI state-handling omissions: alert errors are not propagated, history-load failures share a retry action that only retries sends, and spreadsheet loading is ignored. Reproduce by intercepting respective GET endpoints to503 or delaying spreadsheet history. Backend production APIs showed no current failure; historical supervisor errors predate this refactor/run. Early row-delete/mobile failures resolved after modal/menu animation waits; browser Response.text on SSE was unavailable, so actual completion was verified through rendered answer-source and persisted conversation history.
